title: A Letter Smelling of Honey
summary: Wren, a beekeeper, writes that since the light rose from the Wither's pit her bees have been flying into their nests and never coming out, and she thinks you can follow them. Go and meet her.

quest_book.title: A Letter Smelling of Honey
quest_book.author: Wren the Apiarist
pages:
You don't know me. I keep bees in the village over the hill, or I did.

The night the light rose out of the Wither's pit, my bees flew into their nests and didn't come out. Not dead. Just gone.

My grandmother said there's a country inside the comb. A queen. She went once and came back with honey that glowed.

Come and see me. Please.

- Wren

threats.name: Wren the Apiarist
threats.target_line: You got my letter! Mind the hives. They're nervous, and so am I.
talk: You were standing by the nests like you were listening. My bees are vanishing.
Inside. There's a whole world in there, made of honeycomb. My grandmother went once.
Throw an ender pearl at a bee nest or a hive. Don't ask me how it works. It just does.
